audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially in 3D printing, CAD visualization, and lightweight 3D asset processing workflows.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF, glTF Binary, COLLADA, and 3MF files using Scene.open() with automatic format detection or explicit FileFormat specification.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Exports scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF, glTF Binary, and 3MF formats using Scene.save() with format-specific options for compression, coordinate system, and unit scaling.
capabilities.title: Export to interchange formats

capabilities.text: Build and traverse a hierarchical scene graph using Scene, Node, and Transform classes, supporting child node creation and independent transform control.
capabilities.title: Scene graph manipulation

capabilities.text: Create and edit mesh geometry via control points and polygons, or convert primitives to meshes using to_mesh() for further modification.
capabilities.title: Mesh construction and editing

capabilities.text: Assign LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure color and factor properties for diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness.
capabilities.title: Material assignment

capabilities.text: Build keyframe animations using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence, and store skeletal bind-pose data with Pose and related classes.
capabilities.title: Animation support

limitations.text: FBX import is experimental and FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() raises NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError; image rendering is unsupported.
Texture construction raises NotImplementedError; image-backed textures cannot be created.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation, modification, and export of 3D scenes using a pure-Python API without requiring external SDKs or native binaries.
Supports common 3D interchange formats (OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3MF) for interoperability across design, manufacturing, and visualization tools.
Provides a scene graph model with nodes, transforms, entities, and materials for structured 3D scene composition and traversal.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond those explicitly listed in format facts is unclear; some option classes exist but are not dispatchable.
Whether the public API surface beyond listed symbols is fully implemented or partially stubbed is not verifiable from facts alone.
The behavior of Scene.open() when given a file without a recognized extension or with an ambiguous extension is not documented in facts.
The stability and correctness of the triangulation implementation beyond the existence of PolygonModifier.triangulate() is not quantified.

workflows.name: Import and inspect 3D scenes
workflows.text: Load OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, or 3MF files using Scene.open() and inspect geometry, nodes, and materials.

workflows.name: Build scenes from primitives
workflows.text: Construct parameterized primitives like Box, Sphere, Cylinder, and others, then convert them to editable meshes using to_mesh().

workflows.name: Export scenes to interchange formats
workflows.text: Write scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, or 3MF files using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions for fine-grained control.

workflows.name: Assign materials to geometry
workflows.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.

workflows.name: Construct meshes programmatically
workflows.text: Build meshes from control points and polygons using Mesh.control_points and Mesh.create_polygon(), then attach them to nodes.

workflows.name: Triangulate polygonal geometry
workflows.text: Triangulate arbitrary polygons using PolygonModifier.triangulate() to produce triangle fans suitable for rendering.
